quizzes.title: LEADS 2025 State and UT Categories
quizzes.passage:
The Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade, under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, has released the 7th LEADS 2025 Report. LEADS is India's national index for benchmarking logistics performance across the States and Union Territories of India. It evaluates each State and UT across key logistics parameters, including infrastructure, service quality, regulatory environment, operational efficiency and data-driven logistics reforms.

The 2025 edition introduced a four-tier classification system in place of the earlier model. It places States and UTs in four new categories: Exemplars, High Performers, Accelerators and Growth-Seekers. Each entry also carries a regional tag, and the tags used in the report are Coastal, Landlocked, North-East (N-E) and UTs. The regional tag appears next to each name in these lists.

The report includes a section titled State Performance in LEADS 2025 that lists the States and UTs under each category. Some States and UTs have moved between categories compared with earlier years, so the placement in one edition may differ from the previous one. The four categories and four regional tags together describe each entry in the report.

The same occasion saw the Department confer the LEAPS Awards 2025 to recognise excellence and innovation in India's logistics sector.

questions.q: Which State was categorised as an Achiever from 2022 to 2024 before achieving Exemplar status in LEADS 2025?
questions.explanation: Uttar Pradesh moved from Achiever status (2022 to 2024) to Exemplar status in LEADS 2025.

questions.q: Which Union Territory improved from Fast Mover in 2024 to High Performer in 2025?
options: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
questions.explanation: The report states that Jammu and Kashmir improved from Fast Mover in 2024 to High Performer in 2025.

questions.q: Under which category is Sikkim (N-E) placed in LEADS 2025?
questions.explanation: Sikkim is listed as a North-East entry in the Growth-Seekers category.

questions.q:
Read the assertion and the reason.
Assertion (A): Andhra Pradesh is placed in the Growth-Seekers category in LEADS 2025.
Reason (R): Andhra Pradesh is tagged as a Coastal entry in the report.
options: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
A is false but R is true
A is true but R is false
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
questions.explanation: Andhra Pradesh is an Accelerator, not a Growth-Seeker, while its Coastal tag is correct.

questions.q:
Match List I with List II:
I. Accelerators   ->   A. Sikkim
II. Growth-Seekers   ->   B. Delhi
III. High Performers   ->   C. Punjab
IV. Exemplars   ->   D. Tripura
questions.explanation: Punjab is an Accelerator, Sikkim a Growth-Seeker, Tripura a High Performer and Delhi an Exemplar.

questions.q:
Examine the statements below:
I. The 2025 edition introduced a category named Growth-Seekers.
II. Jammu and Kashmir is placed in the Accelerators category in LEADS 2025.
III. The report uses a regional tag called UTs.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Statements I and III match the report, while Jammu and Kashmir is a High Performer, not an Accelerator.

questions.q:
How many of the statements below are correct?
I. Uttar Pradesh was an Achiever from 2022 to 2024 before becoming an Exemplar.
II. Tripura is placed in the High Performers category with the North-East tag.
III. Andaman and Nicobar Islands is placed in the Accelerators category.
questions.explanation: Statements I and II are correct, while Andaman and Nicobar Islands is a Growth-Seeker, not an Accelerator.

quizzes.title: LEADS 2025 Categories and Tags
quizzes.passage:
LEADS is an index that benchmarks logistics performance across the States and Union Territories of India. The 7th LEADS 2025 Report was released by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade, which sits within the Ministry of Commerce and Industry. The report evaluates each State and UT across logistics parameters such as infrastructure, service quality, regulatory environment and operational efficiency.

The 2025 edition introduced a four-tier classification system. Under this system, States and UTs are placed in categories named Exemplars, High Performers, Accelerators and Growth-Seekers. Each entry carries a regional tag, and the tags are Coastal, Landlocked, North-East and UTs. The tag appears beside the name of each State or UT in the category lists, which are arranged under the heading State Performance in LEADS 2025.

Some entries show a State or UT moving from one category to another compared with earlier years, so placements can differ between editions. The report was released in May 2026 as part of the current affairs compilation under Summits, Reports, Indices.

The initiatives described in the report support PM GatiShakti and the National Logistics Policy 2022. The same release also conferred the LEAPS Awards 2025, which recognise excellence and innovation in India's logistics sector.

questions.q: Which Landlocked State was categorised as an Achiever from 2022 to 2024 before becoming an Exemplar in LEADS 2025? (name of the State)
questions.explanation: Uttar Pradesh was an Achiever from 2022 to 2024 and became an Exemplar in LEADS 2025.

questions.q: Which Union Territory improved from Fast Mover in 2024 to High Performer in 2025? (name)
questions.explanation: Jammu and Kashmir moved from Fast Mover in 2024 to High Performer in 2025.

questions.q: Which Coastal State is placed in the Growth-Seekers category in LEADS 2025? (name)
questions.explanation: West Bengal is a Coastal entry in the Growth-Seekers category.

questions.q: Which Landlocked State is placed in the Accelerators category in LEADS 2025? (name)
questions.explanation: Punjab is a Landlocked entry in the Accelerators category.

questions.q: Which Union Territory is placed in the Exemplars category in LEADS 2025? (name)
questions.explanation: Delhi is the UT entry in the Exemplars category.

questions.q: Which North-East State is placed in the Exemplars category in LEADS 2025? (name)
questions.explanation: Mizoram is a North-East entry in the Exemplars category.

questions.q: Which Coastal State is placed in the Accelerators category in LEADS 2025? (name)
questions.explanation: Andhra Pradesh is a Coastal entry in the Accelerators category.

quizzes.title: Logistics Initiatives and the LPI
quizzes.passage:
The LEADS 2025 Report was released by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade, under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry. It appears alongside a set of national programmes meant to strengthen India's logistics sector. Among these is the PM GatiShakti National Master Plan 2021, which appears in the report's list of initiatives. The report describes LEADS as India's national index for benchmarking logistics performance across the States and Union Territories.

Other programmes listed in the report include the Logistic Efficiency Enhancement Programme, Bharatmala Pariyojana, the Sagarmala Programme and the E-Way Bill System. Each is named as part of the wider effort. The report also notes that logistics costs in India remain relatively high. The 2025 edition also introduced a four-tier classification system.

The LEADS framework evaluates States and UTs across key logistics parameters, including infrastructure, service quality, regulatory environment, operational efficiency and data-driven logistics reforms. The report also refers to the World Bank's Logistics Performance Index. India's position in that index is reported for 2023. The Logistics Performance Index is a World Bank index. The Department also conferred the LEAPS Awards 2025 to recognise excellence and innovation in India's logistics sector.

This topic appears in the May 2026 current affairs compilation under the heading Summits, Reports, Indices.

questions.q: Which programme aims to improve road connectivity across India?
questions.explanation: The booklet states that Bharatmala Pariyojana aims to improve road connectivity across India.

questions.q: Which programme aims to enhance freight speed, reduce costs and improve tracking?
questions.explanation: The Logistic Efficiency Enhancement Programme aims to enhance freight speed, reduce costs and improve tracking.

questions.q: The Logistics Performance Index analyses differences between countries in which of the following respects?
options: Tax rates on freight and fuel prices
Railway passenger fares and tourism flows
Airline ticket prices and cargo volumes
Customs procedures, logistics costs and infrastructure for overland and maritime transport
questions.explanation: The booklet says the index analyses customs procedures, logistics costs and infrastructure quality for overland and maritime transport.

questions.q:
Read the assertion and the reason.
Assertion (A): The National Logistics Policy 2022 aims to bring logistics costs in line with those of other developed countries.
Reason (R): The World Bank reports the Logistics Performance Index every 2 years.
options: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation: Both statements are true, but the reporting frequency of the index does not explain the policy's cost aim.

questions.q:
Match List I with List II:
I. PM GatiShakti National Master Plan 2021   ->   A. Port-led development
II. Bharatmala Pariyojana   ->   B. Digital bills for goods
III. Sagarmala Programme   ->   C. Integrated planning across roads, railways, ports and airports
IV. E-Way Bill System   ->   D. Road connectivity across India
questions.explanation: GatiShakti promotes integrated planning, Bharatmala improves road connectivity, Sagarmala focuses on port-led development and E-Way mandates digital bills.

questions.q:
Examine the statements below:
I. The Logistics Performance Index includes customs performance among its key dimensions.
II. The National Logistics Policy 2022 aims to raise logistics costs.
III. The Logistic Efficiency Enhancement Programme aims to enhance freight speed.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Statements I and III are correct, while the National Logistics Policy aims to lower, not raise, logistics costs.

questions.q:
How many of the statements below are correct?
I. The E-Way Bill System is one of the programmes named in the report.
II. The Logistic Efficiency Enhancement Programme aims to reduce freight speed.
III. Logistics costs in India are around 8.5% of GDP.
questions.explanation: Only statement I is correct, since the programme aims to enhance freight speed and logistics costs are about 7.97% of GDP.

quizzes.title: Logistics Programmes and Index Facts

The report appears in the May 2026 current affairs compilation under the heading Summits, Reports, Indices. LEADS is described as India's national index for benchmarking logistics performance across the States and Union Territories. It evaluates each State and UT across key logistics parameters, including infrastructure, service quality, regulatory environment, operational efficiency and data-driven logistics reforms.

The 2025 edition introduced a four-tier classification system for States and UTs. Its categories are Exemplars, High Performers, Accelerators and Growth-Seekers. The report sits within a wider set of national efforts in logistics. One of these is the PM GatiShakti National Master Plan 2021, which appears in the report's list of initiatives. Several other programmes are also listed, and the report describes each briefly as part of the effort to strengthen the sector.

The report notes that logistics costs in India remain relatively high. It also refers to the World Bank's Logistics Performance Index and to India's position in that index for 2023. Separately, the Department conferred the LEAPS Awards 2025 to recognise excellence and innovation in India's logistics sector.

questions.q: What is the approximate share of logistics costs in India's GDP, according to the booklet? (per cent, number only)
questions.explanation: The booklet states that logistics costs in India are around 7.97% of GDP.

questions.q: How often does the World Bank report the Logistics Performance Index? (in years)
questions.explanation: The booklet says the World Bank reports the Logistics Performance Index every 2 years.

questions.q: Which programme aims to improve road connectivity across India? (name)
questions.explanation: Bharatmala Pariyojana is the programme the booklet says aims to improve road connectivity across India.

questions.q: Which programme focuses on port-led development and boosts coastal shipping efficiency? (name)
questions.explanation: The Sagarmala Programme focuses on port-led development and coastal shipping efficiency.

questions.q: Which system mandates digital bills for goods and eases inter-state transport? (name)
questions.explanation: The E-Way Bill System mandates digital bills for goods and eases inter-state transport.

questions.q: What is the full name of the programme that aims to enhance freight speed, reduce costs and improve tracking?
questions.explanation: The Logistic Efficiency Enhancement Programme aims to enhance freight speed, reduce costs and improve tracking.

questions.q: Which 2022 national policy aims to lower logistics costs to par with other developed countries? (name with year)
questions.explanation: The National Logistics Policy 2022 aims to lower the cost of logistics to par with other developed countries.
